objective: Proof and computation. Blurred signed Z4 on five values (0 doubled) composes like cycles (KNOT-CIRCUITS Theorem 1 and the blurring lemma), fails globally and recognisably on the spaces of B, keeps a knot inside them after a line is removed (at every line at four places), counts #P-complete in general, and counts its solutions there by a short sum. So composing like cycles does not force rigid selection: native composition and emergence-keeping selection coexist, at five values.
status: Proved by RIGID-SELECTION-20261101-001C-P001: blurred signed Z4 on five values composes like cycles (same constrained sets as its image, a law of Z4's coset law; a Mal'tsev lift preserves it), fails exactly where its image fails (recognised over Z4) and globally on both spaces of ticket B, keeps knots inside them (brute force over 5^6 and 5^9), has count matrices of rank 4 (#P-complete by Dyer-Richerby) and counts after a removal as 8 weighted image solutions; by ticket D its kept knots hide at most one digit. At two values composing like cycles forces rigidity, while the knot keeps knots
title: A law that composes like cycles and selects spaces that keep a knot
